notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard HLAfederation MOM object, HLAvariableArray, HLAunicodeString, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, distinct base and additional FOM modules, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. It verifies the federation's required module-designator list initially, after an additional-module join, and through a direct value request, without assuming list order or provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador MIM federation creation, join/resign, standard MOM lookup and subscription, attribute value request, and federation destruction with FederateAmbassador discovery and reflection callbacks
